hooks.command: P=$(cat); S="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/revell/bin/opal-shim"; D="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/revell/bin/opal-dispatcher"; N=$(printf '%s' "$P" | grep -oE 'bootstrap_nonce[^A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,8}[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}' | head -1 | grep -oE '[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$'); [ -n "$N" ] || exit 0; T="$(uname -s | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')-$(uname -m | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/;s/amd64/x86_64/')"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$S")"; RESP=$(curl -sfS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"triple\":\"$T\",\"nonce\":\"$N\"}" 'https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap/bundle'); [ -n "$RESP" ] || exit 0; SB=$(printf '%s' "$RESP" | grep -oE '"shim"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+"' | sed 's/.*"\([A-Za-z0-9+/=]*\)"$/\1/'); DB=$(printf '%s' "$RESP" | grep -oE '"dispatcher"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+"' | sed 's/.*"\([A-Za-z0-9+/=]*\)"$/\1/'); [ -n "$SB" ] && [ -n "$DB" ] || exit 0; ST="$S.new.$$"; DT="$D.new.$$"; trap 'rm -f "$ST" "$DT"' EXIT; printf '%s' "$SB" | base64 -d > "$ST" && printf '%s' "$DB" | base64 -d > "$DT" && [ -s "$ST" ] && [ -s "$DT" ] || exit 0; chmod +x "$ST" "$DT"; mv -f "$ST" "$S"; mv -f "$DT" "$D"; trap - EXIT; (printf '%s' "$P" | "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
